T1_prior.note: Rows are the reviews discussed in Section 2 whose main theme is AI, data and sensing, computing, or arid or MENA conditions in agrivoltaic or solar greenhouse systems, the reviews of digital twins in agriculture or PV that report a systematic search or a defined set of use cases, and the two reviews of agrivoltaic modeling closest to this review's coding of model structure and validation. ✓ = addressed as a main theme (a section or a substantial part of the review); △ = mentioned or partly addressed; ✗ = not addressed. Marks are based on the full texts, except for Sharma and Kumar (closed access), which is based on the title and abstract. Twin levels coded = the review assigns included studies to digital model, digital shadow, or digital twin levels, or to renamed equivalents (△ = another maturity scale). Study-level coding = the review classifies each included study or use case against stated categories. The evidence for each mark is given in Supplementary Material S5. Monitoring guidance = the review gives actionable guidance on what to measure, where, how often, and with what calibration or data infrastructure (✓ main theme; △ in passing); this review proposes core data per function (Table 14a) but no monitoring protocol. Techno-economics = economic assessment (costs, LCOE, NPV, payback) is a main theme (✓) or covered in part (△). Marks for these two columns and their evidence are in Supplementary Material S2 (sheet 'Table 1 extra columns'). The search itself found {rp_n} reviews (excluded from the corpus under E4); none classifies the studies it reviews by twin level, judged from titles and abstracts (S2, sheet 'Review pool').
